# Atharva Patil

> Product designer working across research, prototyping, testing, and front-end
> implementation. Based in Bloomington, Indiana, and open to relocating.
> Currently looking for product design roles.

Atharva designs end to end: discovery research, interaction design, prototyping,
usability testing, and often the front-end code that ships. His work spans
consumer products, care research, and enterprise operations tooling.

## Selected work

- [Streaming Helper](https://atharvapatil.net/work/streaming-helper): A consumer
  product that reduces decision fatigue when choosing something to watch. Grew
  out of a graduate capstone. 30 survey responses, 7 interviews, 5+ iterative
  prototype tests. Independent product designer.
- [MEAD](https://atharvapatil.net/work/mead): Caregiver-facing mobile tooling for
  people living with advanced dementia, built in a six-day sponsor-led sprint
  under UK GDPR constraints. Research, strategy, prototyping, visual design.
- [Field Maintenance](https://atharvapatil.net/work/field-maintenance): A
  maintenance logging workflow for U.S. Department of State embassy engineers,
  developed from 45 stakeholder interviews into a Power Apps and Dataverse MVP.
  UX strategist and design consultant.

## Notes

- [Building this portfolio with an AI-assisted workflow](https://atharvapatil.net/notes/building-this-portfolio):
  How this site was made, from framing the identity in ChatGPT through Figma and
  MCP to writing the code. What moved faster and where judgment still mattered.
- [Extending Porsche's design system without breaking its grammar](https://atharvapatil.net/notes/extending-porsche-design-system):
  Deconstructing a mature design system, recomposing a page from its existing
  parts, and designing one new component that still belonged.
